per_window.ps-ns: Free WT CTD at 15 °C, 11.7 T: rigid (S2 > 0.8, including the N-terminal beta-hairpin; J2, r1) except the last 5-6 C-terminal residues and the H3-H4 loop (J1, r1). Unchanged with the pol eta RIR bound (J5, r4).
per_window.us-ms: Free WT CTD: dynamic_in_window at the RIR-binding pocket by CPMG dispersion (G1161, L1171, W1175, D1186, entry 5, 15, 19, 30) and model-free Rex in the H1-H2 and H3-H4 loops, without kex or pB (J3, r2, r1); F1165 and S1223 broadened beyond detection (J4, r3, unresolved). Pol eta RIR complex: Rex,mf at 1175-1179 (J6, r4); two-field global fit kex 585 ± 23 s-1, pB 5.9 ± 0.4% that mixes binding and intramolecular exchange (J7, r5, unresolved); missing F1165, S1223, V1224 (J8, r6).
per_window.slower_than_ms: Only binding kinetics: pol eta RIR koff and kon[L] below about 33 s-1 (J9, r7, unresolved, not conformational). HDX, time-resolved, EPR and multitemperature data: search_insufficient (J16).
per_window.undetermined: Binding-only rows for PolD3 and XRCC1 RIRs (J10, r9; J11, r17); structure comparisons show the fold unchanged with pol eta (J12, r8), PolD3 (J13, r10) and a Rev7-bound inhibitor complex (J14, r25); shift-predicted ordering of the C-terminal tail on Rev7 binding (J15, r14, r16); RDC/PRE and MD search_insufficient (J17). Not judged: REV1/REV7/REV3 and Rev7-dimer assembly overlays (r11, r12), complex tumbling (r13, r15), docking flexibility settings (r18), equilibrium Kd (r19, r20), the UBM2 and tandem-UBM domains outside the entry (r21-r24), abstract-only in-cell FRET assembly (r26) and cellular FRAP mobility of full-length REV1-eGFP (r27-r29).

protein_summary.wt_apo_answer: Yes, but without a rate: free wild-type human REV1 CTD at 15 °C, pH 7.0 (phosphate, 11.7 T) shows us-ms exchange at its RIR-binding pocket, with CPMG dispersion at G1161, L1171, W1175 and D1186 (entry 5, 15, 19, 30, author-listed examples), model-free Rex in the H1-H2 and H3-H4 loops and F1165 and S1223 broadened beyond detection, but no apo kex or minor-state population was fitted; the only kex (585 ± 23 s-1, pB 5.9%) comes from the 89%-bound pol eta RIR complex and may include peptide on-off exchange.
open_conflicts: Pol eta RIR complex: the fitted kex of 585 s-1 is about twice the authors' 300 s-1 upper bound for on-off exchange, yet the dispersion Δω mostly matches free-bound shift differences (r5); the rows cannot split binding from intramolecular exchange.
The Rev7-complex paper gives the tail as 1246-1251 but its NOE text names K1259, beyond the 1251 C-terminus (r14, r16); kept unmapped.
questions_for_gina: Is the RelaxDB REV1CT R1/R2/NOE set the 15 °C, 11.7 T free-domain data of the 2LSY/2LSK paper (r1)? The input lists no BMRB id.
Should the free-domain us-ms answer rest on 11.7 T dispersion examples without a fitted apo kex, or wait for the full figure-only exchange map (Fig. 5C)?
protein_summary.buffer_note: Row ids are written REV1CT-rN. All Rev1-CT NMR uses 50 mM sodium phosphate with 0.25-1 mM EDTA at pH 7.0-7.1, 15-35 °C; the domain binds neither DNA nor metal and no row tests a buffer effect. The 2012 free and complex relaxation data are single-field (11.7 T) except the complex dispersion (11.7 and 18.8 T); the CPMG R2 at 500 Hz suppresses slow exchange, so Rex,mf reports the faster part of us-ms exchange. The Rev7-complex rows are perdeuterated at 35 °C and are not comparable with the 15 °C data. Constructs 1157-1251 (G1157 remnant) and 1158-1251 cover the same entry sequence and are scored WT; the perdeuterated Rev7-complex sample is marked as another construct. Mouse and yeast REV1 appear only as structural overlays (r11) and are not used.
